diagnosis.summary: The nightly run e7916e3a for 2026-10-01 failed at the ingest step because the order_items landing file for that day was never delivered. The orders, payments and customers files for the same day arrived and look normal, so the gap affects only order_items. I've proposed asking upstream to re-export order_items for 2026-10-01, which is what the runbook says to do. A rerun can only succeed once the file has arrived. If redelivery doesn't fix it, escalate to upstream_app_team.

root_cause.explanation: The file landing/order_items/dt=2026-10-01/order_items.csv is missing, even though the partition directory exists. Ingest failed loudly with IngestError: landing file missing. The 09-30 order_items file was normal, and the other 10-01 tables were delivered with valid headers and continuous id ranges. That points to a one-off export or delivery gap for order_items alone, not a schema or model change.

evidence.claim: Run e7916e3a failed at ingest because order_items.csv for 2026-10-01 is missing
The order_items file is absent from the dt=2026-10-01 directory; the 09-30 file was normal
The other tables for 2026-10-01 were delivered and look normal, so the export ran
The ingest config is at defaults, so no config change caused this
The runbook maps a missing landing file to request_upstream_redelivery, and a rerun alone won't help
If the problem persists after redelivery, escalate to upstream_app_team

alternatives_considered: rerun_only: rejected, because the file is still missing and a rerun would fail the same way
File delivered under another name or path: the tool can only check the contract path, so this can't be ruled out, but redelivery to the contract path fixes it either way
Empty or partial export: ruled out, because ingest found no file at all rather than a header-only one
Model change: not relevant, because the run failed at ingest before any dbt step ran
escalate_to_owner(upstream_app_team): kept as the next step if redelivery fails

proposal.rationale: Ingest failed because landing/order_items/dt=2026-10-01/order_items.csv was never delivered. The other tables for that day arrived complete and the ingest config is at defaults, so this is a one-off delivery gap affecting only order_items. The runbook policy says to request upstream redelivery for a missing landing file. A plain rerun would hit the same error.
